Both pathways converge on Phosphodiesterase 6C as a downstream target, suggesting a possible mechanism involving enzyme inhibition or modulation. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential role for 8-Prenylluteone in modulating Phosphodiesterase 6C activity through different molecular intermediates. The evidence supports a mechanism where 8-Prenylluteone may act as a modulator of Phosphodiesterase 6C via multiple intermediate targets, potentially through competitive inhibition or regulatory interactions.
